appraisal_events.evidence: Il s'est senti un peu dépaysé, cet homme... tu ne voudrais pourtant pas que, la première fois, il ait déjà le ton de la maison comme Cottard qui fait partie de notre petit clan depuis plusieurs années. La première fois ne compte pas.
appraisal_events.explanation: After M. Verdurin notes Swann's social misstep with the pianist's aunt, Mme Verdurin excuses him as a still-unacclimated newcomer, implicitly ranking him below the long-established Cottard as the standard of true clan membership.

appraisal_events.evidence: À la grande surprise de Mme Verdurin, il ne lâcha jamais. Il allait les rejoindre n'importe où... plus souvent au théâtre, que Mme Verdurin aimait beaucoup.
appraisal_events.explanation: Contrary to Mme Verdurin's fear that he might back out, Swann proves unexpectedly and reliably devoted, joining the little clan wherever asked, including the theatre outings she especially loves, marking his successful integration and rise in her esteem.

status_effects.explanation: Swann is locally positioned as a still-unassimilated newcomer, beneath Cottard's established standing in the little clan, though the diminishment is mild and explicitly excused as a first-time lapse.
Swann's surprising, unflagging willingness to join the Verdurins anywhere they go clearly raises his standing and secures his place within the valued social space of the little clan.
